user.title: Connect to Edulog
user.description: Use your Edulog Parent Portal email and password to obtain an access token. Only the access token is saved; the email and password are used only for this sign-in.

reauth_confirm.title: Edulog sign-in expired
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again to replace the expired access token. Your email and password are not saved.

error.invalid_auth: The portal rejected these credentials or returned an invalid login response.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Edulog Parent Portal.
error.wrong_account: These credentials belong to a different Edulog account.

abort.already_configured: This Edulog account is already configured.
abort.reauth_entry_not_found: The Edulog configuration entry could not be found.

init.title: Polling geofence
init.description: Set the diameter around each trip's pickup and drop-off points that triggers faster bus location polling. Map-visible passive Home Assistant zones are created for these points.

reauthenticate.title: Edulog sign-in required
reauthenticate.description: The Edulog access token has expired. Reauthenticate the Edulog Bus Tracker integration from Settings > Devices & services to restore bus updates.
